purpose: Define the non-gold JSON shape a fresh source-only extractor must emit after reading its producer bundle. This contract names no accepted relation, annotation, source span, or reference answer.
rules: Emit exactly one case for every allowed_case_ids value and no other case id.
Copy each case source_revision and raw_record_inventory from the supplied source packets without deriving records from undisclosed material.
Give every accepted relation, unknown, and contradiction at least one complete revision-bound source span.
Use case-local unique identifiers and make relation unknown_ids and contradiction_ids lists of existing case-local annotation ids.
Keep unsupported raw material in rejected_relations or rejected_annotations; do not infer runtime behavior or select an architecture.
handoff: Freeze the emitted candidate and provide its path and SHA-256 to the separate adjudicator. A syntactically valid candidate is not an acceptance receipt.
